title: Scn_V6.4.6-(Stabil)
script:
-- ========================================================
-- ScnHub (V6.4.7 FIX MENÜ - GLOBAL VERSİON)
-- ========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local DATABASE_URL = "https://scn-turk-server-chat-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/mesajlar.json"
local http_request = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or request

-- HAREKET MOTORUNU ARKA PLANDA YÜKLE
local Controls
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local PlayerModule = require(LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule"))
        Controls = PlayerModule:GetControls()
    end)
end)

-- 1. ANA ARAYÜZ (GUI) GÜVENLİ KURULUMU
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "ScnFlyHub"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Executor Güvenlik Aşma
local success, coreGui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if gethui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()
elseif success and coreGui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = coreGui
else
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 183)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.3, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local DragBar = Instance.new("Frame")
DragBar.Name = "DragBar"
DragBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
DragBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
DragBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
DragBar.Parent = MainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", DragBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "⚡ScnHub (V6.4.7 FİX MENÜ-GLOBAL)" 
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 204)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextSize = 12
Title.Parent = DragBar

-- BUTON ŞABLONU
local function createButton(name, text, posX, posY)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.Parent = MainFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    return btn
end

local ToggleBtn = createButton("ToggleBtn", "FLY: OFF", 8, 35)
local NoclipBtn = createButton("NoclipBtn", "NoClip: OFF", 104, 35)
local KalkanBtn = createButton("KalkanBtn", "SHIELD: OFF", 8, 85)
local TpBtn = createButton("TpBtn", "TP (2 TIK): OFF", 104, 85)

-- ================= HIZ KONTROL PANELİ =================
local SpeedFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
SpeedFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 30) 
SpeedFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedFrame.Visible = false 
SpeedFrame.Parent = MainFrame

local DecBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", SpeedFrame)
DecBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 30)
DecBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
DecBtn.Text = "<"
DecBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", DecBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", SpeedFrame)
SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 30)
SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 0)
SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SpeedLabel.Text = "16" 
SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 204)
SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SpeedLabel.Parent = SpeedFrame

local IncBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", SpeedFrame)
IncBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 30)
IncBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 0)
IncBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
IncBtn.Text = ">"
IncBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", IncBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

local RndBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", SpeedFrame)
RndBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 30)
RndBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 0)
RndBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(138, 43, 226) 
RndBtn.Text = "🎲"
RndBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", RndBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- ================= TP PANELİ =================
local TpFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
TpFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 184, 0, 30) 
TpFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TpFrame.Visible = false 
TpFrame.Parent = MainFrame

local RndPlayerBtn = createButton("RndPlayerBtn", "RNDM Player", 0, 0)
RndPlayerBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 30)
RndPlayerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
RndPlayerBtn.Parent = TpFrame

local RndGroundBtn = createButton("RndGroundBtn", "RNDM GROUND", 96, 0)
RndGroundBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 30)
RndGroundBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
RndGroundBtn.Parent = TpFrame

-- ================= LACİVERT CHAT BUTONU =================
local ChatOpenBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
ChatOpenBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 184, 0, 40)
ChatOpenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 128)
ChatOpenBtn.Text = "🌐GLOBAL Chat🌐"
ChatOpenBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ChatOpenBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ChatOpenBtn.TextSize = 13
Instance.new("UICorner", ChatOpenBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local ChatStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ChatOpenBtn)
ChatStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ChatStroke.Thickness = 2
ChatStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

local flying, noclipping, kalkanActive, tpEnabled = false, false, false, false
local flySpeed = 16 

local ChatPanel = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)

local function alignChatPanel()
    if ChatPanel.Visible then
        ChatPanel.Position = UDim2.new(
            MainFrame.Position.X.Scale, 
            MainFrame.Position.X.Offset + MainFrame.Size.X.Offset + 10, 
            MainFrame.Position.Y.Scale, 
            MainFrame.Position.Y.Offset
        )
    end
end

local function updateUI()
    local currentY = 135
    if flying then
        SpeedFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, currentY)
        SpeedFrame.Visible = true
        currentY = currentY + 35
    else
        SpeedFrame.Visible = false
    end
    if tpEnabled then
        TpFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, currentY)
        TpFrame.Visible = true
        currentY = currentY + 35
    else
        TpFrame.Visible = false
    end
    ChatOpenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, currentY)
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, currentY + 48)
    alignChatPanel()
end

-- ================= 100% SİYAH PRO CHAT PANELİ =================
ChatPanel.Name = "ChatPanel"
ChatPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 200)
ChatPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
ChatPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
ChatPanel.Visible = false
Instance.new("UICorner", ChatPanel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local FireStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ChatPanel)
FireStroke.Thickness = 3
FireStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

task.spawn(function()
    local fireColors = {
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 0)
    }
    local index = 1
    while true do
        if ChatPanel and ChatPanel.Visible and ChatPanel:FindFirstChild("UIStroke") then
            TweenService:Create(FireStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Color = fireColors[index]}):Play()
            index = index % #fireColors + 1
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

local ChatTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", ChatPanel)
ChatTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
ChatTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ChatTitle.Text = "🌎GLOBAL🌍CHAT🌏"
ChatTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ChatTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ChatTitle.TextSize = 15

local RulesLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", ChatPanel)
RulesLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
RulesLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 22)
RulesLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
RulesLabel.Text = "ADMİN PANEL. Lütfen kurallara uyun ve spam atmayın! KURUCU/PRODUCER: SCANA279_V3"
RulesLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
RulesLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
RulesLabel.TextSize = 10
RulesLabel.TextWrapped = true
RulesLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

local EmptyLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", ChatPanel)
EmptyLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
EmptyLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.4, 0)
EmptyLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
EmptyLabel.Text = "İLK YAZAN SEN OL!"
EmptyLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
EmptyLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
EmptyLabel.TextSize = 18

local ChatScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", ChatPanel)
ChatScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -95)
ChatScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 58)
ChatScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ChatScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 2
local ListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", ChatScroll)
ListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8) 

local ChatInput = Instance.new("TextBox", ChatPanel)
ChatInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
ChatInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -35)
ChatInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
ChatInput.PlaceholderText = "sohbet etmek için bir şey yaz."
ChatInput.Text = ""
ChatInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ChatInput.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 130)
ChatInput.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
ChatInput.TextSize = 13
Instance.new("UICorner", ChatInput).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

ChatOpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if currentChatMode ~= "GLOBAL" then
        currentChatMode = "GLOBAL"
        ChatTitle.Text = "🌎GLOBAL🌍CHAT🌏"
        RulesLabel.Text = "ADMİN PANEL. Lütfen kurallara uyun ve spam atmayın! KURUCU: SCANA279_V3"
        RulesLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
        clearChatScroll()
    end
    ChatPanel.Visible = not ChatPanel.Visible
    alignChatPanel()
end)

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
DragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        alignChatPanel()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
        dragging = false 
    end
end)

-- ================= GERÇEK GLOBAL CHAT MOTORU & PROFIL SİSTEMİ =================
local displayedKeys = {}

local function addMessageToScreen(sender, message, userId, timestamp)
    if EmptyLabel.Visible then EmptyLabel.Visible = false end
    
    local msgFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ChatScroll)
    msgFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    msgFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    
    local pfp = Instance.new("ImageLabel", msgFrame)
    pfp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
    pfp.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 3)
    pfp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    pfp.Image = "rbxasset://textures/ui/GuiImagePlaceholder.png" 
    Instance.new("UICorner", pfp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    
    local pfpStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", pfp)
    pfpStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128) 
    pfpStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    pfpStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    
    if userId then
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                pfp.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
            end)
        end)
    end
    
    local timeStr = timestamp and " [" .. os.date("%H:%M", timestamp) .. "]" or ""
    
    local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", msgFrame)
    nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 16)
    nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 0)
    nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLbl.Text = sender .. timeStr
    nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 204)
    nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    nameLbl.TextSize = 13
    nameLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    
    local txtLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", msgFrame)
    txtLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 20)
    txtLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 16)
    txtLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    txtLbl.Text = message
    txtLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    txtLbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    txtLbl.TextSize = 14
    txtLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    txtLbl.TextWrapped = true
    
    ChatScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, ListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    ChatScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, ChatScroll.CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
end

local function fetchMessages()
    if not http_request then return end
    pcall(function()
        local response = http_request({
            Url = DATABASE_URL,
            Method = "GET"
        })
        if response and response.StatusCode == 200 and response.Body ~= "null" then
            local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
            if type(data) == "table" then
                for key, msgData in pairs(data) do
                    if not displayedKeys[key] then
                        displayedKeys[key] = true
                        addMessageToScreen(msgData.Yazar, msgData.Metin, msgData.UserId, msgData.Zaman)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        if ChatPanel.Visible then fetchMessages() end
    end
end)

ChatInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed and ChatInput.Text ~= "" then
        local text = ChatInput.Text
        ChatInput.Text = "" 
        
        if http_request then
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    http_request({
                        Url = DATABASE_URL,
                        Method = "POST",
                        Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"},
                        Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
                            Yazar = LocalPlayer.DisplayName, 
                            Metin = text, 
                            Zaman = os.time(),
                            UserId = LocalPlayer.UserId 
                        })
                    })
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    fetchMessages()
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

-- ================= GOD MODE MOTORLARI =================
local bV, bG, flyConnection, noclipConnection, kalkanConnection

DecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() flySpeed = math.max(1, flySpeed - 20) SpeedLabel.Text = tostring(flySpeed) end)
IncBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() flySpeed = flySpeed + 20 SpeedLabel.Text = tostring(flySpeed) end)
RndBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() flySpeed = math.random(1, 1000) SpeedLabel.Text = tostring(flySpeed) end)

RndPlayerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local targets = {}
    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then table.insert(targets, p) end
    end
    if #targets > 0 then
        local target = targets[math.random(1, #targets)]
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
    end
end)

RndGroundBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local rx, rz = math.random(-800, 800), math.random(-800, 800)
        local result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(rx, 1000, rz), Vector3.new(0, -2000, 0))
        if result and result.Instance and result.Instance.CanCollide then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(result.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            break
        end
    end
end)

local function startFlying()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local rootPart = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    bG = Instance.new("BodyGyro", rootPart) bG.P, bG.maxTorque = 9e4, Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9) bG.cframe = rootPart.CFrame
    bV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", rootPart) bV.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9) bV.velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if flying and char and rootPart and hum then
            bG.cframe = Camera.CFrame
            if Controls then
                bV.velocity = Camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Controls:GetMoveVector()) * flySpeed
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFlying()
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() end
    if bV then bV:Destroy() end if bG then bG:Destroy() end
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").PlatformStand = false
    end
end

local function startNoclip()
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() end
    noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if noclipping and LocalPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopNoclip()
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() end
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or part.Name == "Head") then part.CanCollide = true end
        end
    end
end

local function toggleKalkanEffect()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    if kalkanActive then
        if not char:FindFirstChild("SCN_Kalkan") then
            local ff = Instance.new("ForceField") ff.Visible = true ff.Name = "SCN_Kalkan" ff.Parent = char
        end
        if kalkanConnection then kalkanConnection:Disconnect() end
        kalkanConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth then hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end
        end)
    else
        if char:FindFirstChild("SCN_Kalkan") then char.SCN_Kalkan:Destroy() end
        if kalkanConnection then kalkanConnection:Disconnect() kalkanConnection = nil end
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if tpEnabled and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and Mouse.Hit then
            char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end
end)

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    flying = not flying 
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = flying and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) 
    ToggleBtn.Text = flying and "FLY: ON" or "FLY: OFF" 
    updateUI() 
    if flying then startFlying() else stopFlying() end 
end)

NoclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    noclipping = not noclipping 
    NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = noclipping and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) 
    NoclipBtn.Text = noclipping and "WALL: ON" or "WALL: OFF" 
    if noclipping then startNoclip() else stopNoclip() end 
end)

KalkanBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    kalkanActive = not kalkanActive 
    KalkanBtn.BackgroundColor3 = kalkanActive and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) 
    KalkanBtn.Text = kalkanActive and "SHİELD: ON" or "SHİELD: OFF" 
    toggleKalkanEffect() 
end)

TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    tpEnabled = not tpEnabled 
    TpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = tpEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) 
    TpBtn.Text = tpEnabled and "TP (1 TAP): ON" or "TP (1 TAP): OFF" 
    updateUI() 
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    flying, noclipping, kalkanActive, tpEnabled = false, false, false, false
    flySpeed = 16 
    SpeedLabel.Text = "16" 
    updateUI()
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3, ToggleBtn.Text = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50), "FLY: OFF"
    NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3, NoclipBtn.Text = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50), "WALL: OFF"
    KalkanBtn.BackgroundColor3, KalkanBtn.Text = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50), "SHİELD: OFF"
    TpBtn.BackgroundColor3, TpBtn.Text = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50), "TP (2 TIK): OFF"
    stopFlying() 
    stopNoclip()
end)

updateUI()
print("⚡ V6.4.7 FIX MENÜ - GLOBAL VERSİON - PRO! 😎 🔥")
features:

•🇪🇺 you will receive a reply to every chat message you send within 4 seconds. Please do not use profanity or spam! | 🇹🇷 Sizin gönderdiğiniz her sohbet mesajına attığınız mesaj 4 saniye içinde yayınlanacaktır. Lütfen küfür veya spam kullanmayın!
